name: md-glm-pi-card
description: Settings → Models: Fetch models on the glm card with the saved key; Add a model ID with an id pi lists but the server doesn't (left unticked); tick glm-5.3-flash and glm-5.2 (the first with Max output set to the default, the second set back to the defaults with Max output 8192 and thinking off), Add 2 models; after the probes Use on each hint from pi's model list (models.saveModel), then the models.get after the re-probes
notes: Setup (synthetic test setup, docs/specs/model-discovery.md §13.1): a copy of the owner's Mori data dir, encrypted key files only; renamed glm/GLM-5.3 (the provider's only model) to glm/md-real-moved-GLM-5.3 in the copied model-config.json; a temporary project for the glm-pi session turn (no grant: network zones were removed on 2026-10-26), with a project extension that logs the max_tokens of each request pi sends (before_provider_request)
The card fetch used the key saved in Mori: the commands carry no key and the fixture stores no request headers
